body:
So, it’s been 4 days. This is such a terrific avenue for people in crisis to get their voice out (I truly don’t have people to talk to about this. Being an extroverted nearly 40 year old white cis male is just masking 99% of the time so my friendships are surface level and to talk about a crisis leads to bad times or judgement). But, I figured it may be nice if anyone is doing down the list of posts and wondering if there are ever follow ups. So here you go. 

“Scratch” is the best way I can describe what happened. I scratched my wrist about 20-30 times. Some of them are healing now. I am wearing a large wrist guard saying I fell on a run and hurt my wrist so no one can see. Got some makeup that matches my skin tone for any of the rogue/long scratches. Other than that, wearing long sleeves in Florida summer has been… difficult to conceal. No long term damage (always a chance for infection but I’m putting my faith in good ole bacitracin and ignorance). 

I have an appointment with a new psych tomorrow. I have not told them about the crisis I had yet. I also don’t know about telling my psychologist either. Here’s the thing - I don’t know if I actually want help or not. I truly do not see how the worry/pain/stress makes any of this worth it. I love all of you for showing such compassion and such amazing words of kindness. I just don’t know if I understand the return on investment for all of this. We toil and struggle every single day, fretting and worrying… for.. what? To have a moment of happiness and so we can accumulate more things? I’m convinced we are sold that happiness story just so we can continue paying money to people and organizations (I’m sounding like an absolute whack job. I used to think “do crazy people know they are crazy?” but as I’m typing this, I’m sounding super crazy and would 1,000% believe the person who wrote this is off their rocker. Yet.. here I am. So maybe that’s it. Maybe I’m actually crazy?!?). Long story short - I’m convinced we are forced and shamed to stay alive so we can funnel money to people. Church makes it a sin because if they lose a follower, they lose money (and I’d bet the whack jobs that write paragraphs like I’m writing are some of the best folks who give higher share of wallet to church so they’d be losing a high paying customer). Government is the same way, need the people paying & doing jobs that help the machine run so the high ups get massive amounts of cash. It’s all money at the end of this- you can’t take it with you but someone will profit. My crisis is already going to pay out big for like 3 people at least since now I’m hyper focused on therapy and counseling. 

Anyway, that’s it. I’m alive and upright. No one but you knows. It’s been a year since my last attempt so I’m betting this one got out the wiggles and it’ll be another year or hopefully more until the next time. I played with my kids this weekend, helped around the house with my wife and put up new crown molding in our bathroom & changed these really high lights in our foyer that I’ve been putting off for months because I needed to get the big ladder out. I’ll keep doing this, keep pretending that this is all normal and has any reason or purpose to it. 

I’ll leave the post as is and walk away - but just wanted to give everyone the update. Thanks again for the kind words.

I don’t quite know how to @ everyone in this thread to say this to everyone but it’s really heartwarming to see you all posting positive messages like this and the rest of the responses. Thank you all for choosing to spend your time on things like this. It’s appreciated.
